# WebP test fixtures

These original synthetic images are generated by `tests/create-webp-fixtures.c`
using Google libwebp 1.6.0. They contain no third-party photos.

- `lossless.webp`: 2x2 red, half-alpha green, transparent, white pixels.
- `lossy.webp`: lossy encoding of the same pixels, with lossless alpha.
- `animated.webp`: 4x4 transparent canvas, two 2x2 frames at different offsets.
- `large.webp`: 6000x6000 opaque white, above the 32MP preview threshold.
- `oriented.webp`: lossless image with EXIF orientation 6 (90 degree rotation).

To regenerate, configure `native/webp` with `-DFIV_WEBP_BUILD_FIXTURES=ON`,
build target `WebpFixtures`, and run it with this directory as its working
directory. The application DLL includes no encoder.
